questions.prompt: A rectangular paper is folded in half from right to left. One hole is punched near the lower-left corner of the folded rectangle, away from all edges. After unfolding, where are the holes?

choices.A: Near both lower corners, symmetric across the vertical centerline
choices.B: Near both upper corners
choices.C: One near the lower-left corner only
choices.D: Four holes, one in each quadrant

questions.correctAnswer: Near both lower corners, symmetric across the vertical centerline
questions.explanation: Undoing the horizontal half-fold reflects the lower-left punch to the lower-right side.

questions.prompt: A square paper is folded from top to bottom and then from right to left. One hole is punched near the upper-right corner of the final folded square, away from all edges. What appears after unfolding?

questions.prompt: A square paper is folded once along the diagonal from upper-right to lower-left. A small triangular notch is cut from the folded diagonal, away from its endpoints. What appears after unfolding?

questions.prompt: A square paper is folded in half from left to right. The folded rectangle is then folded from bottom to top. A hole is punched near the center of the final folded square, away from all edges. After unfolding, how many holes appear?
